selectedProfile.codebook: Owner-selected immutable opaque codeId to 8-bit address/command pairs; at most16 entries, unique IDs and byte pairs. No raw patterns, repeats, appliance labels or arbitrary carrier.
selectedProfile.frame: [address, address XOR0xff, command, command XOR0xff], each byte LSB first
selectedProfile.canonicalEnvelope: ASCII IRN1, u32be carrier,4 frame bytes,u16be count,67 u32be timings;282 bytes.

authorityAndLifetime: Private activation and per-emission approval are separate from the ordinary reliable public SDK invocation route. Reserve before authorizer/compiler/hash/provider callouts. Original owner/control/operation signals and earliest absolute deadline remain binding. Replay records survive Stop/restart; quota is checked before the next authorizer call.
ownership: Exact in-process selected provider object has one owner token across instances. Stop/timeout/revoke/fault retains ownership through Stop, current operation and first whenSettled, provider close and final whenSettled; then releases only its token. Non-owner or former-owner close is inert. Owner listener detaches on close. This does not establish cross-process or physical hardware exclusivity. A shared unresolved retirement promise is installed before detach/abort/provider callouts; reentrant Stop or close joins one exact cleanup chain and cannot close twice or release ownership before settlement.
softwareProvider: A separately owned Node child validates canonical envelope and hash, holds the software frame duration and reports completion. Every open uses a fresh child plus random128-bit token and generation; stale EMIT/STOP rejected. Receipt is written after close/exit with zero waiters/timers. No GPIO, serial, shell, network or firmware transport.

installedCaller.scope: Actual separate child software NEC32 caller using the verified installed public SDK and separately compiled gateway. Provider completion only; no physical carrier, appliance acknowledgement, observed appliance state, GPIO, remote service or firmware claim.
